, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the Deutsche Biographie snippet, confusing the burial location (Berlin-Kreuzberg) with the place of death, and consequently set the expected death place to “Berlin-Kreuzberg, Berlin, Germany” instead of the correct “Kreuzlingen, Canton Thurgau, Switzerland.”
